summary_en: 300,000 shares (1.39% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), ¥1,350M ceiling, open-market purchase Aug 1–Dec 31, 2026. Purpose: ROE improvement and capital efficiency aligned with medium-term plan; shareholder return enhancement. Note: 2-for-1 stock split effective Oct 1, 2026 will raise the share acquisition limit to 600,000.
title_en: Notice Concerning Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Acquisition of Treasury Stock Based on Articles of Incorporation Pursuant to Article 165(2) of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: Ryoden Corporation announced a buyback program approved by its Board on July 31, 2026. The company will acquire up to 300,000 shares of its common stock (1.4% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum total of ¥1,350 million via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between August 1 and December 31, 2026. The stated purpose is to control the appropriate level of shareholders' equity in line with its medium-term financial strategy, with emphasis on improving capital efficiency (ROE) while enhancing shareholder returns. The disclosure notes that the company plans a 2-for-1 stock split effective October 1, 2026, after which the share acquisition limit will be restated as 600,000 shares.
